name: Code-server
description: Code-server is VS Code running on a remote server, accessible through the browser. - Code on your Chromebook, tablet, and laptop with a consistent dev environment. - If you have a Windows or Mac workstation, more easily develop for Linux. - Take advantage of large cloud servers to speed up tests, compilations, downloads, and more. - Preserve battery life when you're on the go. - All intensive computation runs on your server. - You're no longer running excess instances of Chrome.
short_desc: Code-server is VS Code running on a remote server, accessible through the browser
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: PASSWORD
form_fields.hint: Optional web gui password, if PASSWORD or HASHEDPASSWORD is not provided, there will be no auth.

form_fields.label: HASHED_PASSWORD
form_fields.hint: Optional web gui password, overrides PASSWORD, instructions on how to create it is below.

form_fields.label: SUDO_PASSWORD
form_fields.hint: If this optional variable is set, user will have sudo access in the code-server terminal with the specified password.

form_fields.label: SUDO_PASSWORD_HASH
form_fields.hint: Optionally set sudo password via hash (takes priority over SUDOPASSWORD var). Format is $type$salt$hashed.

form_fields.label: PROXY_DOMAIN
form_fields.hint: If this optional variable is set, this domain will be proxied for subdomain proxying. See Documentation

form_fields.label: DEFAULT_WORKSPACE
form_fields.hint: If this optional variable is set, code-server will open this directory by default

form_fields.label: PWA_APPNAME
form_fields.hint: If this optional variable is set, the PWA app will the specified name.
